segments.description: Coaches, our next presenter is Nick Jacques. Nick is the current coach relationship manager for Tennis Australia in WA. Prior to this, Nick resided in Auckland, New Zealand. Nick is a development coach who specializes in helping young children on a performance tennis pathway. He has worked in the talent identification space for both the LTA and at Wimbledon. Nick was previously part of Tennis New Zealand coach development team, running ITF level one and level two courses. Nick has produced multiple national individual and team champions, where many of these players have entered the top 100 ITF ranking and achieved world ranking points as well. Today, Nick shares some of his insights into how to build a competitive environment within your coaching program where children will thrive. Nick, over to you. Everybody, Nick Jacques here. Firstly, I'd like to thank Scott Rowlands for giving me the opportunity to speak at the virtual conference. It's a huge honour and privilege to be able to speak to you guys about something that I feel very passionate about, competition, but more importantly, connecting competition. This presentation is ultimately an accumulation and a collection of 28 years of my own coaching experience, which I've been very, very lucky to work alongside some phenomenal coaches, great clubs and centres and organisations as well, which were part-landly tennis club, Sutton Tennis Academy, Riverside,
